logs.title: Application logs
logs.description: View the latest slice of the application's runtime log for troubleshooting.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Manage the app theme, interface zoom, and display language.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose a light, dark, or system-matching color scheme.
theme.label: App theme
theme.hint: Dark mode (Ayu Mirage) is tuned for code-dense sessions.

zoom.title: Interface zoom
zoom.description: Scale the whole interface for your display and eyesight. Applies instantly and is remembered.
zoom.label: Zoom level
zoom.hint: Affects the display size of the entire app interface.

monoFont.title: Monospace font
monoFont.description: Choose the monospace font for code, terminals, and diffs. Applies instantly and is remembered.
monoFont.label: Monospace font
monoFont.hint: Falls back to the bundled IBM Plex Mono when the chosen font isn't installed.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface display language. Applies instantly and is remembered.
language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Bilingual coverage is progressive — some screens are still Chinese-only and will be completed over time.

shortcuts.sendModifierEnterHelper: Send with Ctrl / Cmd + Enter; Enter inserts a newline.
shortcuts.sendEnterHelper: Send with Enter; Shift + Enter inserts a newline.
shortcuts.sectionDescription: Rebind keys for the actions below; applies instantly and is remembered.
shortcuts.capturing: Press the new key combination… (Esc to cancel)
shortcuts.sequentialDescription: Two-step chords (e.g. G then S); not rebindable yet.
shortcuts.readOnlyNote: System/raw shortcuts (e.g. Cmd+P, Cmd+,) are not rebindable here yet.

automations.pageDescription: Save a “start turn” as a reusable automation that runs headlessly, manually or on a cron schedule; each run creates a real session you can open in the workspace.
automations.sectionDescription: Only triggers while the app is running; missed schedules are not backfilled.
automations.name: Name
automations.isolationHint: v1 runs in place in the project root workspace (no isolated worktree).
automations.nameAndPromptRequired: Please fill in a name and a prompt
automations.cronRequired: A scheduled trigger needs a cron expression

webService.title: Web Service
webService.description: Manage the local Web service listener, access control, and startup status.
webService.configLoadFailed: Failed to load Web service configuration
webService.statusLoadFailed: Failed to load Web service status
webService.configSaveFailed: Failed to save Web service configuration
webService.saveBeforeStart: Please save the Web service configuration first
webService.statusSectionDescription: The Web service only listens on the local loopback address, for local integration and automated access.
webService.serviceControlDescription: Configuration changes must be saved before starting the service.
webService.accessSectionDescription: The port and token are saved to the local configuration; the token is only used for subsequently protected endpoints.
webService.portDescription: The default port is 17891; using local loopback access only is recommended.
webService.autoStartDescription: Automatically start the Web service when the app launches.
webService.tokenDescription: The token is displayed masked; you can regenerate or copy it.
webService.actionBarMessage: Web service configuration modified; it takes effect after saving.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Manage quick instructions that can be inserted into the task input via #tag_name.
instructions.agentRequired: Please select at least one available agent.
instructions.loadMarketFailed: Failed to load the official marketplace
instructions.deleteConfirmMessage: After deletion, the matching #tag_name snippet in the task input will also become unavailable.
instructions.selectPrompt: Select an instruction on the left to preview or edit.
instructions.marketHint: Adjust the configuration, then write it to local.
instructions.localHint: After saving, keep using #tag_name in the task input.
instructions.nameFieldDescription: Corresponds to #tag_name in the task input.
instructions.agentFieldDescription: All by default; you can also limit it to specific agents.
instructions.contentFieldDescription: The full prompt written into the task input when the instruction is inserted.

modelProviders.title: Model Providers
modelProviders.pageDescription: Select an agent first, then configure providers for it; after applying, the changes are written to that agent's real config file.
modelProviders.emptyDescription: Click "New Provider" in the top right; after applying you can switch this agent's model access.
modelProviders.editDialogDescription: Update the provider's config and key; if this provider is the current one, saving also writes to the config file.
modelProviders.createDialogDescription: Configure a provider for this agent; supports the OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic protocols.
modelProviders.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved; leave blank to keep unchanged
modelProviders.modelListHint: Sync available models from the provider's `/v1/models`; click one to set it as the default model.
modelProviders.previewWriteHint: These files are written when applying
modelProviders.previewEmpty: Enter the API URL to preview the generated config files.
modelProviders.unmanagedDescription: {{agent}}'s provider config is managed by its own client; VibeX cannot switch or write it for now.
modelProviders.applyWritesTo: After applying, writes to {{path}} (the original file is backed up automatically).
